linework.observation: Consistent rounded black contours define protagonist, notebook, equipment cabinets, ladder and watertight door.

colour.observation: Muted navy, gray steel and cream lamp light; restrained naturalistic palette.

shading.observation: Broad soft cel shadows shape the seated pose and metal interior without glossy rendering.

character_construction.observation: The protagonist has the required bald rounded head, nose, ears, brows and mouth.

backgrounds.observation: Enclosed chart nook with sealed hatch, ladder, caged lamp and no exterior opening.

finish.observation: Cleanly rendered with clear detail and no visible glitches.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and junior navy coveralls remain consistent.

content.observation: Notebook, chart and mug support the watch-log scene; solid hatch replaces the impossible outside view.

composition.observation: Seated figure, boots and nearby equipment are all contained within a balanced wide-medium frame.

regions.people_faces: Single bald protagonist writing, with a tired expression.
regions.foreground_props: Notebook, pencil, chart, mug and equipment case.
regions.architecture: Ladder, pipes, lockers and a solid steel watertight hatch.
regions.distance: Hatch and bunk storage define the compact room behind the protagonist.
regions.lighting: Warm caged wall lamp and restrained overhead fill.
